does: Drops a reference to an AI score and frees it when the count at +0x34 reaches zero.

evidence.says: decrements +0x34; at zero frees the map at +0x20 and the entries at +8 and returns the block to the global allocator
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 199 places, the most of any function that ran only in fights

questions.ask: A probe during an enemy's turn that reads the reference count before and after the call would show it dropping, and the block freed at zero.
